cases.title: Principal Input Validation - Valid Numeric and Decimal Values
cases.description: Verify that the 'Principal' input field (data-testid='principal') accepts valid numeric values greater than 0, including decimals like 0.01, and displays them correctly.

cases.title: Principal Input Validation - Invalid Values and Alert
cases.description: Verify that entering a value less than or equal to 0, non-numeric characters, or leaving the 'Principal' field empty prevents calculation and triggers an alert with 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' when clicking 'Calculate' or pressing 'Enter'.

cases.title: Interest Rate Input Validation - Normal and Edge Cases
cases.description: Verify that the 'Interest Rate (%)' input field (data-testid='annual-interest-rate') immediately accepts and displays valid numbers greater than 0, including the minimum valid value of 0.01.

cases.title: Interest Rate Input Validation - Invalid Inputs
cases.description: Verify that entering non-numeric or values less than or equal to 0 in the 'Interest Rate (%)' field prevents input or triggers an appropriate error alert when interacting directly, clicking 'Calculate', or pressing 'Enter'.

cases.title: Number of Years Input Validation - Valid and Invalid Handling
cases.description: Verify that the 'Number of Years' input field (data-testid='number-of-year') accepts only numeric values greater than 0, reflects valid entries accurately, and triggers the 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' alert upon invalid inputs when clicking 'Calculate' or pressing 'Enter'.

cases.title: Number of Times in a Single Year Input Validation - Edge Case and Invalid Handling
cases.description: Verify that the 'Number of Times in a Single Year' input field (data-testid='number-of-times-in-year') accepts numeric values supporting the minimum valid value of '1' and triggers the 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' alert for non-numeric, negative, or zero values upon calculation triggers.

cases.title: Compound Interest Calculation Workflow - Valid Inputs
cases.description: Verify that the Compound Interest Calculator computes the correct value using the formula CI = principal * (1 + (interest / (ntime * 100)))^(ntime * nyear), rounds to two decimal places, and updates 'result-value' when valid positive inputs are provided and calculation is initiated via 'Calculate' button or 'Enter' key.

cases.title: Compound Interest Calculation Workflow - Invalid Inputs Alert
cases.description: Verify that the system displays an alert with the message 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' if any of the calculator inputs are invalid during a calculation attempt.

cases.title: Enter Key Calculation and Result Preservation
cases.description: Verify that pressing the Enter key while focused on any input field triggers the compound interest computation and displays the result in [data-testid='result-value']. If any input is invalid, display the 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' alert and ensure the result section remains unchanged, displaying '0'.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_24-R-1: Testable behavior includes validating the 'Principal' input field (data-testid='principal') for numeric values > 0. Normal path accepts positive numbers and decimals (e.g., 0.01). Abnormal paths include empty fields, non-numeric characters, and values <= 0, which must trigger an alert with 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' and block calculation. Boundaries include 0, 0.01, and negative numbers. Triggers include clicking 'Calculate' (data-testid='calculate-button') and pressing 'Enter'.

e2edev_bench_24-R-2: Testable behavior includes validating the 'Interest Rate (%)' field (data-testid='annual-interest-rate'). Normal path accepts numbers > 0 (e.g., 5). Edge case accepts the minimum valid value 0.01 and displays it immediately. Abnormal paths include non-numeric values and values <= 0, preventing input or displaying an alert. Triggers include direct interaction, clicking 'Calculate', and pressing 'Enter'.

e2edev_bench_24-R-3: Testable behavior includes validating the 'Number of Years' field (data-testid='number-of-year') for numeric values > 0. Normal path accepts valid positive numbers. Abnormal paths include invalid or non-positive values, triggering the alert 'Please Enter Valid Values!!'. Triggers include clicking 'Calculate' and pressing 'Enter' while focused on any input field.

e2edev_bench_24-R-4: Testable behavior includes validating the 'Number of Times in a Single Year' field (data-testid='number-of-times-in-year'). Normal path accepts numeric values >= 1, supporting the minimum valid value '1'. Abnormal paths include non-numeric, negative, or zero values, triggering the alert 'Please Enter Valid Values!!'. Triggers include clicking 'Calculate' and pressing 'Enter'.

e2edev_bench_24-R-5: Testable behavior includes the Compound Interest Calculator workflow across all four input fields (principal, annual-interest-rate, number-of-year, number-of-times-in-year). Normal path calculates CI = principal * (1 + (interest / (ntime * 100)))^(ntime * nyear), rounds to two decimal places, and updates 'result-value'. Abnormal path triggers 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' if any input is invalid. Triggers include clicking 'Calculate' or pressing 'Enter'.

e2edev_bench_24-R-6: Testable behavior includes triggering calculation via the Enter key from any input field. Normal path computes and updates 'result-value'. Abnormal path triggers the alert 'Please Enter Valid Values!!' for any invalid input and ensures the result section remains unchanged, displaying '0'.
